row.evidence_locator: Section 2; temperature, soft targets and combined objectives
row.narration_en: The update reduces this input’s loss to about 0.9933, improving target matching. Deployment can run only the student; its architecture determines resource use and task quality needs separate testing.
row.narration_zh: 这次更新把该输入的损失降到约0.9933，说明目标匹配改善。部署时可以只运行学生；资源开销由学生结构决定，业务质量仍要单独测试。
row.source_title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
row.takeaway_en: Lower training loss is not proof of task accuracy or measured speedup.
row.takeaway_zh: 损失下降不是业务精度达标，也不是已测得加速。
row.title_en: Deploy the student and assess retained capability
row.title_zh: 部署学生，验证能力是否保留

row.evidence_locator: Section 2; temperature, soft targets and combined objectives
row.narration_en: Cross-entropy measures how the student probabilities match the teacher target. This example uses T=1 and only the soft-target loss, initially about 1.0986.
row.narration_zh: 交叉熵衡量学生概率与教师目标的匹配情况。这里温度T=1，只演示软目标损失，初始值约为1.0986。
row.source_title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
row.takeaway_en: Learning uses probabilities for all classes, not only the top class.
row.takeaway_zh: 次高类别的概率也参与学习，不只看最大类别。
row.title_en: Use the distribution as a learning target
row.title_zh: 用概率分布定义学习目标

row.evidence_locator: Section 2; temperature, soft targets and combined objectives
row.narration_en: The teacher assigns probabilities [0.6,0.3,0.1]; the student initially assigns 1/3 to every class. The student learns the teacher’s response, rather than copying its parameters.
row.narration_zh: 教师给出三类概率[0.6,0.3,0.1]；学生最初对三类都给出1/3。学生要学习的是教师对输入的判断，而不是直接拷贝教师参数。
row.source_title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
row.takeaway_en: Teacher outputs provide a training signal.
row.takeaway_zh: 教师输出提供训练信号。

row.evidence_locator: Section 2; temperature, soft targets and combined objectives
row.narration_en: Take one illustrative update to the student output logits: the first rises and the other two fall. Recomputing softmax gives about [0.4260,0.3156,0.2584], rather than directly substituting the teacher probabilities.
row.narration_zh: 对学生输出logit做一次教学更新：第一类上调，另外两类下调。重新计算softmax后，概率约为[0.4260,0.3156,0.2584]，不是直接替换成教师概率。
row.source_title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
row.takeaway_en: This is one output-logit update; training a complete model also backpropagates to its parameters.
row.takeaway_zh: 这里演示输出logit的一步更新；完整模型训练还需反向传播到参数。
row.title_en: Update with a gradient, then inspect probabilities
row.title_zh: 按梯度调整，再看概率变化

row.evidence_locator: Sections 2.3 and 3.1; model/ephemeral sparsity and structured pruning
row.narration_en: A kernel supporting this pattern can skip zero multiplies and produce [2,6], reducing each original output by 0.2. A real method must also check task quality and execution overhead.
row.narration_zh: 支持该稀疏模式的算子可以跳过零值乘法，得到[2,6]；与原输出相比，两项都减少0.2。实际方案还要检查任务质量与执行开销。
row.source_title: Sparsity in Deep Learning: Pruning and growth for efficient inference and training in neural networks
row.takeaway_en: This is unstructured pruning; structured pruning can also change matrix dimensions and adjacent layers.
row.takeaway_zh: 本例是非结构化剪枝；结构化剪枝还会调整矩阵尺寸与相邻层。
row.title_en: Fewer connections can change the output
row.title_zh: 少做连接计算，也会改变输出

row.evidence_locator: Sections 2.3 and 3.1; model/ephemeral sparsity and structured pruning
row.narration_en: For this teaching example, remove weights with |w|<0.5: the 0.1 and 0.2 connections. The mask zeros those entries; the matrix remains 2×2 while nonzeros drop from four to two.
row.narration_zh: 本例用|w|<0.5作教学选择规则，移除0.1和0.2两个连接。掩码把对应权重置零，矩阵仍是2×2，非零元素从4个减少到2个。
row.source_title: Sparsity in Deep Learning: Pruning and growth for efficient inference and training in neural networks
row.takeaway_en: Pruning is the removal operation; this result has 50% element sparsity.
row.takeaway_zh: 剪枝是删除操作；这一结果具有50%的元素稀疏率。

row.evidence_locator: Sections 2.3 and 3.1; model/ephemeral sparsity and structured pruning
row.narration_en: Two inputs pass through four weighted connections to produce [2.2, 6.2]. Keep every connection as the baseline for comparison.
row.narration_zh: 两个输入经过四个带权连接，产生输出[2.2,6.2]。这里先保留所有连接，作为后续比较的基准。
row.source_title: Sparsity in Deep Learning: Pruning and growth for efficient inference and training in neural networks
row.takeaway_en: This example changes which connections are retained, not their bit width.
row.takeaway_zh: 本例改变连接的保留情况，不改变数值位宽。
row.title_en: See the connections in the computation
row.title_zh: 先看哪些连接参与计算

row.evidence_locator: Sections 2.3 and 3.1; model/ephemeral sparsity and structured pruning
row.narration_en: Dense storage still contains four positions: [2,0,0,3]. A sparse representation stores the nonzero values together with their row and column positions, whose overhead must also be counted.
row.narration_zh: 稠密表示仍保存[2,0,0,3]四个位置。示意稀疏表示只保存非零值，但还需保存它们所在的行和列；索引开销也必须计入。
row.source_title: Sparsity in Deep Learning: Pruning and growth for efficient inference and training in neural networks
row.takeaway_en: Halving nonzeros does not automatically halve total storage.
row.takeaway_zh: 非零数减半，不等于总存储量减半。
row.title_en: How zeros are stored affects memory use
row.title_zh: 零值怎样存，决定是否省空间

row.evidence_locator: Section 2.1–2.4; affine mapping and integer arithmetic
row.narration_en: Start with the first row: −0.875 is closest to −1, so its code is 0, written 00. The remaining rows use the same rule and receive 01, 10 and 11.
row.narration_zh: 先看第一行：−0.875更接近刻度−1，因此选择编码0，即00。其余三行按同一规则，依次得到01、10、11。
row.source_title: Quantization and Training of Neural Networks for Efficient Integer-Arithmetic-Only Inference
row.takeaway_en: A code identifies a representation level; it does not retain the original fractional detail.
row.takeaway_zh: 编码记录选择了哪个等级，不保存原数的小数部分。
row.title_en: Choose a code for each value
row.title_zh: 给每个数选择一个编码

row.evidence_locator: Sections 2–4; quantization parameters, PTQ and QAT
row.narration_en: Keep the four original values unchanged. A separate 0.875 probe produces code 4, outside the range 0–3; clipping to 3 reconstructs 0.5, with error −0.375.
row.narration_zh: 原四个数保持不变。另加一个0.875探针：它算出的编码4超出0到3的范围，被裁到3，只能重建为0.5；误差增大到−0.375。
row.source_title: A White Paper on Neural Network Quantization
row.takeaway_en: Bit width, range and error trade off; actual speed also depends on unpacking and kernels.
row.takeaway_zh: 位数、范围和误差需要取舍；实际加速还取决于解包与计算核。

row.evidence_locator: Section 2.1–2.4; affine mapping and integer arithmetic
row.narration_en: The group has four values, each stored in 16 bits: 64 bits in total. Quantization shortens the code for each value while keeping four values.
row.narration_zh: 这组权重有四个数，每个数用16个bit保存，共64 bit。量化要缩短每个数的编码，数的个数仍是四个。
row.source_title: Quantization and Training of Neural Networks for Efficient Integer-Arithmetic-Only Inference
row.takeaway_en: What changes is the number of representation bits.
row.takeaway_zh: 先看清：改变的是表示位数。

row.evidence_locator: Section 2.1–2.4; affine mapping and integer arithmetic
row.narration_en: Replace four 16-bit representations with four 2-bit codes and pack them as 00011011: one byte. This teaching layout stores the step in 16-bit FP16 and the zero point in 8-bit UINT8.
row.narration_zh: 四行16-bit编码换成四行2-bit编码，按图中顺序打包成00011011，只占1字节。步长按FP16存16 bit、零点按UINT8存8 bit，是本演示明确约定的布局。
row.source_title: Quantization and Training of Neural Networks for Efficient Integer-Arithmetic-Only Inference
row.takeaway_en: Code payload: 64→8 bits; 32 bits including shared parameters, before alignment or container overhead.
row.takeaway_zh: 编码载荷64→8 bit；加共享参数共32 bit，未含对齐与容器开销。
row.title_zh: 真正存下的是短 bit 串

row.evidence_locator: Section 2.1–2.4; affine mapping and integer arithmetic
row.narration_en: Two bits provide four codes: 00, 01, 10 and 11. With step 0.5 and zero point 2, they represent −1, −0.5, 0 and 0.5; unsigned codes can represent negative values.
row.narration_zh: 2 bit只有00、01、10、11四种编码。本例用步长0.5、零点2，把它们对应到−1、−0.5、0、0.5；非负编码也能表示负数。
row.source_title: Quantization and Training of Neural Networks for Efficient Integer-Arithmetic-Only Inference
row.takeaway_en: The step sets spacing; the zero point identifies the code for zero.
row.takeaway_zh: 步长规定间隔，零点规定哪个编码代表0。
row.title_en: Which four values can 2 bits represent?

row.evidence_locator: Section 2.1–2.4; affine mapping and integer arithmetic
row.narration_en: Decode the short codes with the same step and zero point to obtain −1, −0.5, 0 and 0.5. The errors are −0.125, +0.125, −0.125 and +0.125; the lost detail is not recovered.
row.narration_zh: 读出短码后，用同一组步长与零点得到−1、−0.5、0、0.5。与原值相比，各行误差为−0.125、+0.125、−0.125、+0.125，原来的细节没有完整恢复。
row.source_title: Quantization and Training of Neural Networks for Efficient Integer-Arithmetic-Only Inference
row.takeaway_zh: 少用位数，换来了表示误差。

row.narration_en: For x=[1,0,1], first compute Bx=4, then multiply A by 4 to obtain [4,8,12,16]. Direct multiplication by the original matrix gives the same result.
row.narration_zh: 输入x=[1,0,1]，先算Bx=4，再用A乘4，得到[4,8,12,16]。直接用原矩阵乘x，也得到同样结果。
row.source_title: SVD-LLM: Truncation-aware Singular Value Decomposition for Large Language Model Compression
row.takeaway_en: The computation is A(Bx); the factors cannot be swapped.
row.takeaway_zh: 计算顺序是A(Bx)，不是交换两个因子。
row.title_en: Compute the same output in two stages
row.title_zh: 两步计算得到同一个输出

row.narration_en: Change the bottom-right value from 12 to 13 and reuse the same factors: the new matrix’s last output is 17, while the factors still produce 16. This illustrates lost information; the old factors are not claimed to be the new matrix’s optimal SVD.
row.narration_zh: 把右下角12改成13，再用刚才的两个因子近似：新矩阵输出最后一项为17，因子计算仍为16。这展示信息损失，并不声称旧因子是新矩阵的最优SVD解。
row.source_title: SVD-LLM: Truncation-aware Singular Value Decomposition for Large Language Model Compression
row.takeaway_en: The example reduces parameter count by about 41.7%; speed depends on both multiplies and the intermediate result.
row.takeaway_zh: 本例参数减少约41.7%；实际速度还取决于两次乘法和中间结果。
row.title_en: When structure is not exact, approximation introduces error
row.title_zh: 不能完全重复时，只能近似

row.narration_en: Put the row multipliers in a 4×1 matrix A and the shared row in a 1×3 matrix B. Their product exactly matches the original: twelve parameters become seven, with intermediate dimension r=1.
row.narration_zh: 把每行的倍数放入4×1矩阵A，把共用行放入1×3矩阵B，乘积恰好等于原矩阵。参数由12个变成7个，中间维度r=1就是本例的秩。
row.source_title: SVD-LLM: Truncation-aware Singular Value Decomposition for Large Language Model Compression
row.takeaway_en: Factor shapes must be compatible; this example has an exact factorization.
row.takeaway_zh: 因子形状必须相容；本例可以精确分解。
row.title_en: Represent it with two smaller matrices

row.narration_en: Each row of this 4×3 matrix is 1, 2, 3 or 4 times [1,2,3]. It contains twelve values, but its rows are not independent.
row.narration_zh: 这个4×3矩阵的每一行，分别是[1,2,3]的1、2、3、4倍。它包含12个数，但这些行并不独立。
row.source_title: SVD-LLM: Truncation-aware Singular Value Decomposition for Large Language Model Compression
row.takeaway_en: Low-rank factorization uses linear dependence, not arbitrary matrix splitting.
row.takeaway_zh: 低秩分解利用线性相关性，不是任意切开矩阵。
row.title_en: Find repeated structure in the matrix
row.title_zh: 先发现矩阵中的重复结构
